structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a lively creative marketing agency building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant billboard frame on its roof showing only bold abstract colour blocks.
character: young marketing intern (a man in his early 20s, curly black hair, mint green jumper, lanyard)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and checks a laptop showing colourful abstract line graphs and bar charts.
he stands at a big planning wall covered in colourful sticky notes and a calendar grid, planning with two teammates.
he types at a desk while abstract speech bubbles and envelope shapes float up out of his laptop.
a meeting room with a designer: a mood board of colour swatches and abstract poster sketches on the wall.
he presents a big rising arrow chart on a screen to his manager, who gives a thumbs up; the city at dusk outside.
props: a giant megaphone, a target with an arrow in the bullseye, envelopes, heart and thumbs-up icons, a magnifying glass, paper planes, a winding cable
